Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);
BEGIN

:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:=null; --- This variable is referenced by the library
:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:=null;

IF :ctrl_block.unit_id is not null then 

 If Length (:ctrl_block.unit_id)= 15 then
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_block.unit_id,1,13);
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='I';
 Elsif length (:ctrl_block.unit_id)= 7 then
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_block.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar:='C';

 if ltrim(:ctrl_block.unit_id,'0987654321') is not null then 
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='A';
 else
 :GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme:='N';
 end if;
 Else
 show_error('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;

 VALIDATE_UNIT_ID_FORMAT(:GLOBAL.isbt_or_codabar,:GLOBAL.codabar_unit_scheme,:ctrl_block.unit_id);

 :GLOBAL.unit_id:=szUnitId; -- This global value is used in the block property of unit test results

 IF :ctrl_block.from_date is not null and :ctrl_block.to_date is not null THEN
 BEGIN
 Select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from donations
 Where unit_id = szUnitId
 and coll_date between :ctrl_block.from_date AND :ctrl_block.to_date ;
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('16070');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 Select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x from donations
 Where unit_id = szUnitId ;
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error('16070');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF; 

END IF;

END;

DECLARE
 sCount NUMBER:=0;

 FUNCTION check_over_selections return boolean is 
 overSel VARCHAR2(1);
 Begin
 -- This check is added by Edwin becuase the system could not handle if more than 130 selection has been made
 go_block('valid_interdictions');
 first_record;
 overSel:='N';
 Loop
 If :valid_interdictions.chk_box = 'Y' then
 sCount:=sCount + 1;
 if sCount > 130 then
 overSel:='Y';
 end if;
 End if; 

 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 End loop;

 if overSel ='Y' then
 return(FALSE);
 else
 return(TRUE);
 end if;
 END check_over_selections;

--Check over

BEGIN

IF check_over_selections then 

 :ctrl_block2.lv_select := 'FALSE';
 populate_selection;
 check_package_failure;
 If :ctrl_block2.lv_select = 'TRUE' then
 :ctrl_block.inter_code := 'MULTI';
 :ctrl_block.inter_desc := substr(:ctrl_block2.display_str,1,50);
 --substr(:ctrl_block2.inter_str_or,15); 
 --'Multiple Selection of Interdiction Codes';
 if :ctrl_block2.rg_operation = 'A' then
 :ctrl_block.oper := 'AND' ;
 else
 :ctrl_block.oper := 'OR';
 end if;
 go_item('ctrl_block.from_date');
 Else
 --message('Err. No interdiction code Selected');
 go_item('ctrl_block2.inter_type');
 show_error('17026');
 check_package_failure;
 End if;
ELSE
 show_error('16221');
 check_package_failure;
END IF;


END;

PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :don_cursor.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_SELECTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_selection IS
 rg_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'PF_GROUP'; 
 rg_id RecordGroup; 
 gc_id GroupColumn; 
 h_group_row_count number;
 ref_record_number number;
 curr_group_row number;
 flag number;
 errcode NUMBER; 
 q_str_or varchar2(30000) := '';
 q_str_and varchar2(30000):= '';
 disp_str varchar2(30000) := ''; 
 rCount NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
 flag := 0;
 rg_id := Find_Group(rg_name); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name);
 rCount:=0;
 END IF;

 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'inter_code',CHAR_COLUMN,5); 
 
 go_block('valid_interdictions');
 first_record;
 loop
 if :valid_interdictions.chk_box = 'Y' and 
 :valid_interdictions.inter_code is not null then
 :ctrl_block2.lv_select := 'TRUE';
 add_group_row(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 -- curr_group_row := get_group_row_count(rg_id); commented by Edwin on02/24/03
 rCount:=rCount + 1;
 -- set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',curr_group_row,:valid_interdictions.inter_code);
 set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',rCount,:valid_interdictions.inter_code);
 --set_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_desc',curr_group_row,:valid_interdictions.inter_desc);
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;

 /* populate user selection back to dvt_block */
 if :ctrl_block2.lv_select = 'TRUE' then
 hide_window('window2');
 end if;
 h_group_row_count := get_group_row_count(rg_id);
 if h_group_row_count > 0 then
 q_str_or := 'inter_code IN ( ';
 q_str_and := '( ';
 disp_str := '';
 for i in 1 .. h_group_row_count
 loop 
 q_str_or := q_str_or||''''||
 get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',i)||'''' ;
 q_str_and := q_str_and||' (select donor_id,unit_id from donor_interdictions where ';
 q_str_and := q_str_and||' inter_code = '''||get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',i)||'''';

 IF :ctrl_block.show_release = 'N' THEN
 q_str_and := q_str_and || ' and release_date is null ';
 END IF;
 q_str_and := q_str_and||' UNION ';
 q_str_and := q_str_and||' select donor_id,unit_id from donation_interdictions where ';
 q_str_and := q_str_and||' inter_code = '''||get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',i)||'''';

 IF :ctrl_block.show_release = 'N' THEN
 q_str_and := q_str_and || ' and release_date is null ';
 END IF;

 q_str_and := q_str_and|| ' )';


 disp_str := disp_str||get_group_char_cell('PF_GROUP.inter_code',i);
 if i < h_group_row_count then
 q_str_or := q_str_or||',';
 q_str_and := q_str_and||'intersect ';
 disp_str := disp_str||',';
 end if;

 -- message(To_char(Length(q_str_and))||' Count='||to_char(i));pause;
 end loop;
 q_str_or := q_str_or||' )'; 
 q_str_and := q_str_and||' )'; 
 end if;
 -- message('after query string');pause;

 IF NOT Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 Delete_Group( rg_id ); 
 END IF; 
 :ctrl_block2.inter_str_or := q_str_or;
 :ctrl_block2.inter_str_and := q_str_and;
 :ctrl_block2.display_str := disp_str;
 --message(q_str_and);pause;
 --go_item('ctrl_block.from_date');

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_VALID_INTERDICTIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE query_valid_interdictions IS
q_str varchar2(1500);
t_str varchar2(1500); 
begin
 q_str := 'inter_code in ( Select inter_code from
 valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id and
 vi.inter_owner in (''D'',''B'') and
 vi.inter_type != ''DR'' and
 vu.access_class = va.access_class and
 va.access_code_type in (''INTER'',''PROPR'') and
 va.access_code_value = vi.inter_code and
 sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,sysdate+1) and
 sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,sysdate+1)
 union
 Select inter_code from
 valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id and
 vi.inter_owner in (''D'',''B'') and
 vi.inter_type != ''DR'' and
 va.access_class = vu.access_class and
 va.access_code_type in (''INTER'',''PROPR'') and
 va.access_code_value = ''ALL'' and
 sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,sysdate+1) and
 sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,sysdate+1) )';
t_str := ' inter_type = :ctrl_block2.inter_type and inter_code in ( Select inter_code from
 valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id and
 vu.access_class = va.access_class and
 vi.inter_type != ''DR'' and
 va.access_code_type in (''INTER'',''PROPR'') and
 va.access_code_value = vi.inter_code and
 sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,sysdate+1) and
 sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,sysdate+1)
 union
 Select inter_code from
 valid_interdictions vi,valid_acl_codes va,valid_user_access_classes vu
 where vu.user_id = :banner.user_id and
 vi.inter_type != ''DR'' and
 va.access_class = vu.access_class and
 va.access_code_type in (''INTER'',''PROPR'') and
 va.access_code_value = ''ALL'' and
 sysdate between vi.eff_date and nvl(vi.term_date,sysdate+1) and
 sysdate between vu.eff_date and nvl(vu.term_date,sysdate+1) )';

 if :ctrl_block2.inter_type is not null then
 set_block_property('valid_interdictions',default_where,t_str);
 else
 set_block_property('valid_interdictions',default_where,q_str);
 end if; 
 go_block('valid_interdictions');
 execute_query;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_FROM_TO_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_from_to_dates ( fromdate in date,
 todate in date
 ) 
IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

 if fromdate is not null then
 if fromdate > v_local_date then
 show_error('2140');
 end if;
 end if;
 if fromdate is not null and todate is not null then
 if fromdate > todate then
 show_error('9192');
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_DON_CURSOR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_don_cursor IS
 chk boolean;
 q_str varchar2(5000);
 q_hdr varchar2(30000):= null;
 q_query varchar2(5000);
 ft_str varchar2(30000);
 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;
 nGroupRowCount number;
 nCurrGroupRow number;
 n_total_records number;
 rtn_value number;
 bt_qry varchar2(30000);
 temp_unit varchar2(15);
 wh_bt varchar2(2000);
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);

 PROCEDURE generate_from_to_clause is
 begin
 if :ctrl_block.from_date is not null then 
 ft_str := ' and (donor_id,d.unit_id) in ' ||
 '(Select donor_id,unit_id ' ||
 'from donations ' ||
 'where unit_id = '|| temp_unit || 
 'and coll_date between to_date('''||
 :ctrl_block.from_date || ''',''DD-MON-RR'') and to_date('''||
 nvl(:ctrl_block.to_date,sysdate) || ''',''DD-MON-RR'')'; 
 end if; 
 if :ctrl_block.from_date is null 
 and :ctrl_block.to_date is not null
 then 
 ft_str := ' and (donor_id,d.unit_id) in 
 (Select donor_id,unit_id
 from donations 
 where unit_id = ' || temp_unit || ' 
 and coll_date <= to_date('''||:ctrl_block.to_date||''',''DD-MON-RR'')';
 end if; 
 end; /* gen_from_to_clause *//* In Sql the last parenthesis is open */
 
 PROCEDURE generate_donation_type_clause is
 begin
 generate_from_to_clause;
 if :ctrl_block.donation_type is not null then
 if ft_str is not null then 
 ft_str := ft_str || 
 ' and donation_type = '''||:ctrl_block.donation_type||''')';
 else 
 ft_str := ' and (donor_id, d.unit_id) in 
 (Select donor_id, unit_id 
 from donations 
 where unit_id = ' || temp_unit || ' 
 and donation_type = '''||:ctrl_block.donation_type||'''))' ;
 end if;
 else 
 -- Take care of last parenthesis
 if ft_str is not null then 
 ft_str := ft_str || ')'; 
 end if;
 end if; 
 end; /* gen_donation_type_clause */



 PROCEDURE generate_where_clause is /* for donor_interdictions */
 begin
 generate_donation_type_clause;
 if :ctrl_block.inter_code = 'MULTI' then
 if :ctrl_block2.rg_operation != 'A' then 
 if ft_str is not null then 
 q_hdr := ft_str||' and '||:ctrl_block2.inter_str_or;
 else 
 q_hdr := :ctrl_block2.inter_str_or;
 end if;
 else 
 if ft_str is not null then
 q_hdr := ft_str||' and '||'(donor_id,d.unit_id) in '||:ctrl_block2.inter_str_and;
 else 
 q_hdr := '(donor_id,d.unit_id) in '||:ctrl_block2.inter_str_and;
 end if;
 end if;
 elsif :ctrl_block.inter_code is not null then/* not MULTI */
 if ft_str is not null then 
 q_hdr := ft_str||' and inter_code = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.inter_code) ; 
 else 
 q_hdr := ' inter_code = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_block.inter_code); 
 end if;
 else
 if ft_str is not null then 
 q_hdr := ft_str;
 end if;
 end if;
 if :ctrl_block.show_release = 'N' then 
 if q_hdr is not null then
 q_hdr := q_hdr||' and release_date is null ' ; 
 else 
 q_hdr := ' and release_date is null '; 
 end if;
 end if;
 --set_block_property('donor_interdictions',DEFAULT_WHERE,'unit_id is not null and '||q_hdr);
 end;
 
BEGIN

 IF Length(:ctrl_block.unit_id)=15 then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_block.unit_id,1,13);
 Else
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_block.unit_id;
 End if;

 if :ctrl_block.unit_id is null then 
 temp_unit := ' unit_id ';
 --temp_unit := ' :ctrl_block.unit_id ';
 else 
 temp_unit := in_quotes(szUnitId);
 end if;
 generate_where_clause;

 if q_hdr is null then
 /*raise form_trigger_failure;*/
 show_error('17004');
 end if; 

 
 bt_qry := 'SELECT unit_id, inter_code, inter_type, ' ||
 'eff_date, term_date, release_date, ' ||
 'release_user, originated_from, reason_code, ' ||
 'donor_id, insert_date, chapter_id, ' ||
 'transaction_id, note_id, term_reason, ' ||
 '''D'' src ' ||
 'FROM donor_interdictions d ' ||
 'WHERE decode(d.chapter_id, ''ALL'','|| in_quotes(:global.chapter_id) ||', d.chapter_id) =' ||in_quotes(:global.chapter_id) || q_hdr ||
 ' UNION ' ||
 'SELECT d.unit_id, di.inter_code, di.inter_type, d.coll_date, ' ||
 'di.term_date, di.release_date, di.release_user, ' ||
 'di.originated_from,
 di.reason_code, ' ||
 'd.donor_id, di.insert_date, di.chapter_id, ' ||
 'd.transaction_id, null note_id, term_reason, ' ||
 '''U'' src '||
 'FROM donation_interdictions di, donations d ' ||
 'WHERE di.transaction_id = d.transaction_id ' ||
 'AND di.chapter_id = d.chapter_id ' ||
 'AND decode(di.chapter_id, ''ALL'', '|| in_quotes(:global.chapter_id) || ', di.chapter_id) =' || in_quotes(:GLOBAL.chapter_id) || q_hdr;


 bt_qry := '(' || bt_qry || ') don_int '; 

 set_block_property('DONOR_INTERDICTIONS',QUERY_DATA_SOURCE_NAME, bt_qry);
 count_query;
 :ctrl_block.total_count := get_block_property('DONOR_INTERDICTIONS', QUERY_HITS);
 --synchronize;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_DEFAULT_VALUES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_DEFAULT_VALUES IS
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);
BEGIN

 IF Length(:ctrl_block.unit_id)=15 then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_block.unit_id,1,13);
 Else 
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_block.unit_id;
 End if;


 IF :ctrl_block.unit_id is not null THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT nvl(:ctrl_block.from_date,coll_date),
 nvl(:ctrl_block.to_date,coll_date) 
 INTO :ctrl_block.from_date, :ctrl_block.to_date
 FROM donations
 WHERE unit_id = szUnitId
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 :ctrl_block.from_date := nvl(:ctrl_block.from_date,sysdate);
 :ctrl_block.to_date := nvl(:ctrl_block.to_date,sysdate);
 END;
 return;
 ELSIF :ctrl_block.from_date is null and :ctrl_block.to_date is null 
 THEN
 :ctrl_block.from_date := trunc(sysdate) - 3;
 :ctrl_block.to_date := trunc(sysdate);
 ELSIF :ctrl_block.to_date is null 
 and :ctrl_block.from_date is not null
 THEN
 IF :ctrl_block.from_date + 3 > sysdate THEN
 :ctrl_block.to_date := sysdate;
 ELSE
 :ctrl_block.to_date := :ctrl_block.from_date + 3;
 END IF;
 ELSIF :ctrl_block.to_date is not null 
 and :ctrl_block.from_date is null
 THEN
 :ctrl_block.from_date := :ctrl_block.to_date - 3;
 END IF;
END;
